Our procedure exempts commercially introduced beneficial insects, but wild arrivals must be collected into ventilated cages, held through inspection for roughly 36 hours, and released into nearby habitat. The draft importer settings are file_type: csv; record_key: bay_id,species; origin_lookup: released_species; preserve_source_rows: true; output: inspection_register. With this lookup, any insect whose species appears on our commercial release list is entered as “commercially introduced.” The audit template calls that field “actual provenance.” Please include who checks the imported register, cage checks during the holding period, and how the crew records release into nearby habitat. We have enough ventilated cages if collection is required. The crew will use printed sheets, so leave space for initials.
